about: Sprint 21 (S21-3, O-1): the hosted projects' sign-in settings, as they must be. Every deploy reads each project's settings (read-only, with the project's own access token) and fails, naming the difference, if they do not match; nothing here is applied automatically (Q4). Change a setting in the Supabase dashboard (Authentication) and here in the same change. Field names are the Management API's (GET /v1/projects/{ref}/config/auth).
